extraction.prompt: Read only printed pages 44-57, corresponding to PDF pages 48-61, of the verified official LIXIL Giesta2 / Giesta2 fire-rated catalog part. Extract a small auditable set of atomic evidence candidates only about explicitly labeled product/spec groupings such as k2, k2 with sill/plinth, k4, interior/exterior same-taste specification, fire-rated k2, fire-rated k4, and fire-rated interior/exterior same-taste specification. Map only to specific_spec, configuration, or construction when the wording on the cited page directly supports that mapping. Do not extract prices, colors, design IDs, or order codes. Do not infer hidden compatibility or absence. If a claim cannot be mapped atomically to the allowed canonical field scope, return an issue instead. Do not approve or write Product Master, Authoring, Runtime, Registry, Production, or Canonical files.
